environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet behind internal ALB. The ALB has a listener rule at priority 1 with a fixed-response 403 action as default, and a forward rule at priority 5 conditioned on source-ip matching a prefix list (pl-0a8f2e7c4b) containing only the Step Functions VPC endpoint CIDR 10.200.16.0/28 and the monitoring subnet 10.200.32.0/24. The NLB in front performs TLS termination and has a target group health check on /health. VPC flow logs are enabled with REJECT logging. The container task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with a dedicated tmpfs mount (size 64MB, noexec). Security group sg-0f4a8812bc allows ingress only from sg-0e7721aabb (the internal ALB SG) on port 8080.

config.network: private subnet, no internet gateway, internal ALB
